node: Data-center power distribution and electrical balance-of-system: switchgear, transformers, busbars, breakers, UPS subcomponents, power modules, and grid interconnect services
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the AI data-center electrical balance-of-system node. The strongest underfollowed mapping is not generic data-center real estate but the execution layer: custom electrical distribution gear, field electrical services, engineered infrastructure solutions, and electrical-path products that can determine whether a data-center shell can actually be energized. Reference leaders such as Eaton validate the demand signal, but the discovery lane highlights Powell Industries, IES Holdings, and Atkore as smaller or less obvious public-market mappings. Claims are kept at Layer 1B universe-expansion standard; direct backlog/order evidence is strongest for Powell and IES, while Atkore is included as a weaker second-order electrical-products hypothesis needing segment/customer verification.
